    /\ (UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_Put"} => Proc[n].ProcCmd = "NODE_Get")

    /\ (n # Home /\ Proc[n].ProcCmd = "NODE_GetX" => Proc[n].CacheState = "CACHE_I")

FToken(n) == Proc[n].CacheState = "CACHE_E" \/ UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_PutX"

       /\ Dir.Dirty

  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" => /\ Dir.Dirty /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put")
  /\ (UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_Put" => Dir.Dirty)
  /\ (Dir.Dirty /\ Dir.Local => Proc[Home].CacheState = "CACHE_E")
  /\ (Proc[Home].CacheState = "CACHE_E" => Dir.Local)

\* A pending transaction is forwarding, collecting invalidations, or
\* awaiting exactly one of the directory completion messages.
FForward(n) == UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_GetX"} /\ UniMsg[n].Proc # Home
FHomeReply == UniMsg[Home].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"}
FNoForward == \A n \in NODE : ~FForward(n)

FDirBasics ==
  /\ (Dir.HeadVld => Dir.HeadPtr \in NODE \ {Home})
  /\ (~Dir.ShrVld => Dir.ShrSet = {})
  /\ Dir.ShrSet \subseteq NODE \ {Home}
  /\ (Dir.Dirty /\ ~Dir.Local => Dir.HeadVld)
  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" => ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE \ {Home})

FForwardInv ==
  \A n \in NODE : FForward(n) =>
    /\ UniMsg[n].Proc \in NODE \ {n, Home}
    /\ Dir.Pending /\ ~Dir.Local /\ ~Collecting
    /\ PendReqSrc = n /\ PendReqCmd = UniMsg[n].Cmd /\ FwdCmd = UniMsg[n].Cmd
    /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"
    /\ ~FHomeReply
    /\ (Dir.Dirty => UniMsg[n].Proc = Dir.HeadPtr)
    /\ (UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_Get" => RpMsg[n].Cmd # "RP_Replace")
    /\ \A m \in NODE \ {n} : ~FForward(m)

FCollectInv ==
  Collecting =>
    /\ Dir.Pending /\ ~Dir.ShrVld
    /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"
    /\ ~FHomeReply /\ FNoForward
    /\ PendReqSrc \in NODE
    /\ Dir.InvSet \subseteq NODE \ {Home, PendReqSrc}
    /\ Dir.InvSet = {n \in NODE : InvMsg[n].Cmd # "INV_None"}
    /\ Dir.InvSet # {}
    /\ \A n \in NODE : UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_PutX" =>
         /\ UniMsg[n].Proc = Home /\ PendReqSrc = n

FInvLink ==
  /\ InvMsg[Home].Cmd = "INV_None"
  /\ RpMsg[Home].Cmd = "RP_None"
  /\ (UniMsg[Home].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_GetX"} => UniMsg[Home].Proc # Home)
  /\ \A n \in NODE : InvMsg[n].Cmd # "INV_None" => Collecting

FShared(n) == Proc[n].CacheState = "CACHE_S" \/
                (UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[n].InvMarked)
FRegistered(n) == IF n = Home THEN Dir.Local ELSE
                     Dir.HeadVld /\ (Dir.HeadPtr = n \/ (Dir.ShrVld /\ n \in Dir.ShrSet))
FSharedRegs ==
  \A n \in NODE :
    (~Collecting /\ FShared(n) =>
         /\ (FRegistered(n) \/ (n = Home /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_Put")
               \/ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" /\ ShWbMsg.Proc = n))
         /\ \A m \in NODE : ~FToken(m)
         /\ WbMsg.Cmd # "WB_Wb"

         /\ (RpMsg[n].Cmd = "RP_Replace" => /\ Dir.HeadVld /\ Dir.HeadPtr = n))
FSharedCollect ==
  \A n \in NODE :
    (Collecting /\ FShared(n) =>
         /\ n \in Dir.InvSet /\ InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_Inv")
FSharedData ==
  \A n \in NODE :
    /\ (Proc[n].CacheState = "CACHE_S" =>
           Proc[n].CacheData = IF Collecting THEN PrevData ELSE CurrData)
    /\ (UniMsg[n].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[n].InvMarked =>
           UniMsg[n].Data = IF Collecting THEN PrevData ELSE CurrData)
